For a Functional Analyst, client satisfaction and the fulfilment of business goals go hand in hand. Your ability to communicate fuels collaboration, as you navigate between client requirements and our business goals. You’ll work across departments with development teams and stakeholders. You understand how it all works, with experience in functional analysis, requirement gathering, and solution design. Your expertise means you’re always confident in your ability to take initiative, engage your analytical eye and solve problems while performing critical planning, process modelling, and aligning software applications. Your familiarity with Agile/SCRUM methodologies, programming languages, database management, and cloud computing, combined with your strong teamwork, listening skills, and critical thinking abilities, are the reasons you excel in this position.

What else should you know?

• You will work on challenging projects at top companies
•  You work in an open corporate culture with room for personal development
• You work in a high- tech environment with focus on knowledge and innovation
• You can participate in a large number of workshops, trainings and events
• 
You get growth opportunities and the chance to map out your own career path

 

Your profile

• Bachelor or Master degree in Computer science or equivalent through experience
• Good listening and communication skills
• Strong focus and commitment
• Critical and analytical mindset
• Experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies 
• 
Fluent in Dutch/ French and English

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

As a data engineer, you will help our clients with building a variety of data applications in the cloud. Your role will involve working with the latest technologies to develop and manage data solutions tailored to their needs. Your responsibilities include the following: 

• Gather business requirements and translate them to technical specifications. 
• Design, implement and orchestrate scalable and efficient data pipelines to collect, process, and serve large datasets. 
• Apply DataOps best practices to automate testing, deployment and monitoring. 
• 
Continuously follow & learn the latest trends in the data world 

 

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following: 

• At least 2 years of experience as a Data Engineer or in software engineering in a data context 
• Programming experience with one or more languages: Python, Scala, Java, C/C++, … 
• Knowledge of relational database technologies/concepts and SQL is required 
• Experience building, scheduling and maintaining data pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Data Factory, ...) 
• Practical experience with at least one cloud provider (GCP, AWS or Azure). Certifications from any of these is considered a plus 
• Knowledge of Git and CI/CD 
• Able to work independently, prioritize multiple stakeholders and tasks, and manage work time effectively 
• You have a degree in Computer Engineering, Information Technology or related field 
• 
You are proficient in English, knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a plus.

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

As a PowerBI consultant, you will help our clients solve complex BI issues. You collect data from different sources,build sustainble datamodels, optimize datasets for reporting and develop user-friendly PowerBI dashboards. Based on your own expertise and the Sopra Steria BI methodology, you increase the quality of reporting and visualization at our customers. In addition, your input will contribute to the vision and development of our Data Visualization team. 

Understanding data is important. With the Sopra Steria solution for Data visualization, we help organizations do just that. We do this by visualizing information and data. We make abstract information accessible and understandable. Based on the right insights, we can then make data driven decisions about next actions  Microsoft technologies such as PowerBI, Fabric, Azure, ...  hold no secrets for us. 

Within our Data Visualization team we want to help each other and keep learning from each other. We do this by working closely together within the team. So are you looking for new challenges with great colleagues and a steep learning curve? Then the Data Visualization team at Sorpa Steria is the right place for you. 

 

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following: 

• You have at least 3 year of experience with data visualization and can demonstrate this with a demo or portfolio 
• You have at least 3 year demonstrable experience with PowerBI 
• You have experience with performance tuning of PowerBI solutions 
• You dare to be creative, but do not lose sight of the details 
• Knowledge of best practices and visual design principles
• You act as an expert and coach people 
• You communicate fluently, both with your colleagues and the customer 
• A good knowledge of data modeling and dimensional modeling concepts.. 
• Knowledge of HTML/CSS and programming languages such as javascript, python, C# is also a plus 
• Data visualization is your passion 
• Adding your dashboards or portfolio in the application is a plus 
• Knowledge of exernal tools like Tabular editor are a plus 
• You are proficient in English, knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a plus

Your impact as Senior Digital Transformation / Business Enterprise Architect :

The Utilities market is in full transition. At Sopra Steria, we are enthusiastically participating in the digital acceleration within this sector through our Industry and Services market. We aim to grow our advisory agency for Utilities, helping our clients efficiently deal with both current and future challenges in energy transition and sustainable resource management by optimizing processes, improving asset utilization, and enhancing customer experiences.

Your role & responsibilities as Senior Digital Transformation / Business Enterprise Architect :

As a Business Enterprise Architect, you will occupy a key position, crucial to growing our advisory agency within the utilities sector. You will play a significant role in expanding our Industry and Services market, and in executing our strategy to become the preferred digital business partner of our clients by 2026. Your role will be key in architecting digital solutions and strategies that put our clients at the forefront of the energy transition and smart utility management in a rapidly evolving market while driving the growth of our advisory services.

• Design and architect digital transformation initiatives for energy, water, and waste management utilities.
• Lead business framing and solution architecture for key digital themes such as (Transformation consulting, cybersecurity, Data & AI, applications & integrations, cloud & infrastructure).
• Develop enterprise architecture blueprints that align IT direction with business objectives.
• Actively contribute to growing our advisory agency by identifying new opportunities and expanding our client base in the utilities sector.
• 
Create and implement innovative architectural strategies to increase our market share in the Utilities sector, with a focus on digital transformation and sustainability.

 

Your profile as Senior Digital Transformation / Business Enterprise Architect :

• Min 10 years’ experience of IT architecture experience, with 5+ years in digital transformation for the Utilities sector.
• Fluent in Dutch and English; French is a plus.
• Proven track record in digital transformation initiatives, particularly in the energy sector and or water management projects.
• Strong understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and digital themes specific to utilities (e.g., Smart Grid, Energy Transition, Water Management Systems).
• Professional network in the Utilities sector.
• Excellent communication skills, able to articulate complex concepts to diverse stakeholders.
• Strategic mindset with the ability to bridge business strategy and technical implementation.
• Passion for innovative technology solutions in utilities, especially in areas of sustainability and resource efficiency.
• Entrepreneurial spirit with a focus on growth and business development in the evolving utilities landscape.
As a member of one of Europe’s largest digital solutions providers, you’ll benefit from extensive career development opportunities, both local and international. At the Sopra Steria Academy, you’ll be part of a dynamic network of 56,000 professionals at all stages of their careers. With a wide array of offices to explore, you can find your ideal location and take the next step in your career. You’ll become a part of a major Tech player in Europe recognised for its consulting, digital services, and software development

You love working with data and are an expert in developing and implementing various statistical and machine learning. You will work in a multidisciplinary team, including data engineers, cloud architects, analysts, ...

• Good communication and presentation skills
• Ability to understand business needs and transform them into solutions
• Master or PhD in Computer Science
• Fluency in Dutch and English
Plus:

• 
Experience with big data (Spark, Hadoop,Cloud, Databricks ...)

What’s more fundamental in IT than a Digital Workplace that is fully adopted by end users?
Develop, design, and build the future with us as a Microsoft 365 Workplace Solution Architect.

You will be part of the “Data Integrated Digital Workplace” practice with an in-depth expertise combination on Microsoft’s Modern Workplace (SharePoint and MS 365), Data Business Intelligence (SQL & Azure Data Warehousing and Power BI),and low-code development frameworks on Azure.
You and the team share the vision and passion “to create & develop Digital Workplaces with true Business value & adoption” by offering end-users integrated platforms where they find, get pushed and can act upon all the right information, data and documents, at the right time and in the right business context.
You will work with Client’s Business & Technical employees to capture, discuss, create, build, deliver & verify solutions.

 

Profile

• [Must-have] You have a broad view on the entire Microsoft 365 “Modern Workplace” portfolio including Teams & SharePoint
• [Must-have] You have experience and/or a talent to deliver results-driven workshops with the customer to capture requirements, explain the new way of working that can be realized with out-of-the-box M365, and the benefits that can be realized.
• [Must-have] You have experience and/or a talent to work with in-depth technical experts to get the defined solutions created.
• [Must-have] You have experience and/or a talent to guide customers in adopting the solutions on your own or with specialized adoption and change managers.
• [Nice-to-have] You have expertise or affinity with the Microsoft Security, Compliance & Identity solutions to secure customers’ Modern Workplace
• [Nice-to-have] You have expertise or affinity with Microsoft Defender and Intune to secure customers’ Endpoints of their Modern Workplace
• [Nice-to-have] You have expertise or affinity with the Microsoft Power low-code Platform to further automate and increase productivity in customers’ Modern Workplace
• [Nice-to-have] You have expertise or affinity with Front-end and/or Back-end(.NET) development of solutions
• [Nice-to-have] You’re ready to drive change and bring creative tech ideas to life.
• [Nice-to-have] You’re either proficient in Dutch or French (or you want to learn) and fluent in English.
• [Bonus-points] MS 365 certified (or willing to obtain). Certifications in scope: MS-900, MS-600, etc.
• [Bonus-points] MS Power Platform certified (or willing to obtain). Certifications in scope: PL-900, PL-200, etc.
• [Bonus-points] MS Security, Compliance & Identity certified (or willing to obtain). Certifications in scope: SC-900, SC-300, etc.

Who are we?  
Devoteam G Cloud is the Devoteam entity dedicated to Google Cloud technologies. We're a growing team of Google Cloud enthusiasts and are looking for senior profiles to boost our Data & Analytics Tribe. 
We Set the pace. We Move together. We go Big! A bold claim ? As a Premier Google Cloud partner, we implement innovative Google Cloud solutions & leverage cutting-edge AI & Machine Learning technologies. It’s pretty damn cool. And on top of it, we get to experiment with it!

Together, we go big & get the best out of each other. Every day! 

Can we challenge you?

 

Job Description

Your mission?  ‍

As Lead Data Engineer, you will be at the heart of our customers data strategy. You’ll define how it should be structured and help them make decisions that are data-driven. Alongside Sven, our Head of Data & Analytics, you will sync with the customer and define what can be done with the data they have and how it can be used to tackle different business challenges. You will be constantly supported by one of our PM’s in order to deliver best in class solutions in the emerging cloud market. You will constantly be supported by the Data Tribe that is full of fellow engineers with a can-do mentality.

 

Qualifications

Required to have? 

• Experience with Terraform, CI/CD
• Have a know how of data-architecture and data-infrastructure
• Experience with Data Engineering & data pipelines 
• Pipeline development experience with Python, Golang or Java 
• Experience in Google Cloud or other cloud environments & data processing solutions
• You are familiar with Agile & Scrum methodologies
• You are not afraid to interact with senior management & customers 
• You will be a ‘role model’ for the more junior people in the team
• You speak excellent English and preferably French or Dutch
Nice to have

• You know your way around tools like Apache Spark, Beam and/or Kafka 
• 
Enjoy coaching & mentoring a team

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

You are fully convinced that data science isn’t a hype, but you also believe that, in order to be valuable and really make a company smarter, it must be done right. Your goal is therefore to create the most impactful solution possible in the quickest and easiest way possible so that real value can be extracted from data and artificial intelligence. 

Are you brimming with fresh ideas to lead our Data Science team in providing data-driven solutions to our customers based on the latest machine learning models and deep learning algorithms? If you are looking for a new challenge with a steep learning curve, and the support of a dynamic team, you may be our next Data Scientist.

As a Data Scientist, you will dive into the world of artificial intelligence. You will apply your skills to real scenarios and in different domains, such as drug discovery in healthcare, fraud detection in banks, the development of recommendation systems in the retail sector, and more.

 

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following:

• At least 3+ years of experience in Data Science.
• Master's degree (or equivalent through experience) in a field that is highly data-driven. 
• Experience with some of the following data science techniques: supervised and unsupervised learning models, deep learning, anomaly detection, recommender systems, natural language processing, computer vision and reinforcement learning.
• Well versed in open-source software and libraries in Python and/or R for machine and deep learning.
• Extensive experience in building and implementing advanced analytics solutions backed up with some reference cases.
• Experience with big data and platforms such as Azure Machine Learning Services and Amazon SageMaker is a plus.
• Experience in one of the following languages: Python, R, Spark, Scala, Java or C++.
• You are resident in Belgium and look forward to working a few days a week at the client's office.
• 
You are fluent in Dutch or French and in English.

Your responsibilities
 
In this role, you will play a crucial part in translating client needs into sustainable data solutions, encompassing ETL processes, Infrastructure as Code, interfaces, and pipelines.

• Designing data solutions, balancing cost and maintainability.
• Collaborating with Data Scientists, BI specialists, and Business Consultants to deliver value.
• Staying abreast of the latest developments in data technology and actively sharing knowledge with colleagues.
• Monitoring the quality and stability of data solutions.
• Mentoring and coaching other Analyticals Engineer.
 
Your qualifications
 

Do you have 4 to 6 years of experience, including at least 2 years in a cloud environment? Do you possess a passion for approaching projects from an end-to-end data perspective? We are delighted to receive your personal application and we’ll contact you for an interview and a (virtual) cup of coffee.

 

• You can adeptly apply diverse data modeling styles and collaborate with our customers to develop the optimal data model for their needs.
• You grasp data structures & formats and are familiar with popular (cloud) data warehouses.
• You navigate DBT with expertise, effortlessly crafting a new project, playing with all the DBT-blocks to build a castle from the ground up.

CI/CD, which may sound like a secret code, is a realm you navigate with ease. You not only grasp its steps but can also articulate why it's indispensable for any data project. Moreover, you possess the skills to autonomously set it up.
• You approach challenges with an analytical and solution-oriented mindset, and you're well-acquainted with agile methodologies and collaborative teamwork.
• Experience with Docker and PySpark is a plus;
• Experience with dataframe API’s in Python (Panda’s, Polars, ...);
• Fluent in Dutch and/or French and English.

We're looking for an experienced Fullstack Analyst Developer with solid front-end expertise, particularly with React and .NET, to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be able to contribute to the design, development and maintenance of software applications used by our customers.

Working with an experienced team, he/she will actively participate in the continuous improvement of our processes and software architecture.
 

Main responsibilities
 

• Analysis and Design: Analyze functional and technical requirements and design appropriate software architectures.
 
• Fullstack development: Develop and maintain complex web applications, with particular emphasis on the frontend using React and TypeScript, while ensuring seamless integration with backend APIs in .NET.
 
• Performance Improvement: Optimize the performance and user experience of front-end applications to ensure smooth, responsive use.
 
• Testing and Quality: Participate in technical and quality testing phases to ensure the reliability of developed functionalities.
 
• Support and Maintenance: Collaborate with teams to maintain existing modules and adapt IT solutions to specific customer needs.
 
• Continuous Improvement: Contribute actively to the improvement of internal processes and development practices, in particular through code reviews.
 

Your profile

• Education and experience: Significant experience in software development and databases.
 
• Technical skills:
 
• Expertise in React, TypeScript, and React ecosystem tools (Redux, React Router).
 
• Good knowledge of .NET backend development and relational databases (SQL Server appreciated).
 
• Proficiency in versioning tools (Git) and CI/CD processes.
 
• Good command of Microsoft Office suite and .NET Framework (VB.NET, ASP.NET, C#).
 
• Analytical and Communication Skills: Analytical mind and ability to solve complex problems, with attention to detail and respect for delivery deadlines. Excellent communication skills in French, with good knowledge of English.
 
• 
Personal qualities: Ability to work effectively in a team, adapt quickly in an Agile environment and develop a positive working attitude with technical teams, colleagues and customers.

Introduction
For one of our fastest growing practices we are looking for a Data Quality Assurance Specialist. 

Do you have 3 to 5 years of experience of which at least 2 to 3 years in the field of data analysis and/or data quality? And the prospect of helping to grow a company that believes in together creating an impact with Data at our customers sounds good? 

Then we are delighted to receive your personal application and we’ll contact you for an interview and a (virtual) cup of coffee.

 
Your responsibilities
• Support clients in the execution of activities of the data quality cycle: data analysis, data quality assessment, impact assessment, etc. Allowing them to independently monitor, prevent and remediate emerging critical data quality issues.
• Evaluate data from data sources to identify and interpret trends. Identify data quality issues, determine business impact, find out the root cause, collaborate to resolve, and make recommendations for long-term solutions.
• Gather data from data sources to identify and interpret trends, optimize its efficiency and quality by analyzing and cleansing it, as well as resolving data quality issues.
• Run data queries to identify coding issues and data exceptions.
• Support clients in their journey towards becoming data-driven by bridging the gap between business and technology and advising them on best practices, tooling, implementation processes, ...
• Implement data quality principles, processes, and standards and embed them into the clients’ daily operating rhythm to improve trust in both business and technical data domains.
• Collaborate with business and database/application developers to improve processes, system- and database designs.
• 
Follow-up on the latest developments and trends in data quality analysis and tooling.

 

Your Qualifications
• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (engineering, IT, information management, etc.) or equivalent in experience.
• 2 to 5 years of experience in consulting or service-oriented environments, and at least 2 years of experience in data analysis.
• Experience with data quality tooling e.g., Collibra DQ, Soda, Great Expectations, Informatica CDQ, etc..
• Knowledge of data landscapes within an organization, understanding of end-to-end data flows (source to consumer), data architecture, and data engineering / -science principles.
• Affinity with use cases such as Business Glossary, Data Catalog, Data Lineage or Reporting Governance is a plus.
• Proven success in contributing to a team-oriented environment.
• Excellent leadership, communication (written and oral) and interpersonal skills.
• Fluent in Dutch and/or French and English.
 
Skillset
• Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Proficiency in SQL supplemented with at least one other scripting language (e.g., Python, Groovy, R, etc.)
• Experience with Data Quality tooling.
• 
Experience with data governance solutions (Collibra, Datahub, Purview, etc.) is a plus.
